title: Bases and degrees in the iterated Frobenius-image field tower
statement: Let $K$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$, where $p$ is prime [def-weil-field], [def-pc-field-characteristic]. Put $L_i=K^{p^i}=\{x^{p^i}:x\in K\}$ for every integer $i\geq0$, as subfields of $K$ [def-pc-field-extension]. Suppose $d=[K:L_1]$ is finite [def-pc-field-tower], and let $(b_j)_{0\leq j<d}$ be any $L_1$-basis of $K$ [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. For each $i\geq0$, the map $\alpha_i:K\to L_i$, $x\mapsto x^{p^i}$, is a field isomorphism carrying $L_1$ onto $L_{i+1}$, and $(b_j^{p^i})_{0\leq j<d}$ is an $L_{i+1}$-basis of $L_i$. Consequently $[L_i:L_{i+1}]=d$ for every $i\geq0$ and $[K:L_n]=d^n$ for every $n\geq0$, with $L_0=K$ and $[K:L_0]=1$. No perfectness of $K$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 09G9 (fields-lemma-multiplicativity-degrees), applied to the power-image tower in varieties.tex Tag 0CCG (varieties-remark-n-fold-relative-frobenius); basis transport under the injective Frobenius powers is the explicit algebraic refinement.

proof.text: By [def-weil-ring-frobenius], $f_i(x)=x^{p^i}$ is a unital ring endomorphism of $K$. Its kernel is zero: if $f_i(z)=0$ and $z\ne0$, then $1=f_i(z)f_i(z^{-1})=0$, a contradiction. If $f_i(x)=f_i(y)$, apply this to $x-y$ to get $x=y$, proving injectivity. Its image $L_i$ contains $0,1$, is closed under subtraction and multiplication, and contains $f_i(x)^{-1}=f_i(x^{-1})$ for $x\ne0$. Thus $L_i$ is a subfield, and corestriction gives the field isomorphism $\alpha_i:K\xrightarrow{\sim}L_i$.

source.place: Tag 03SM (varieties-definition-absolute-frobenius), following paragraph on the ring Frobenius; elementary injectivity and image calculation (compare fields.tex Tag 09FU, fields-lemma-field-maps-injective).

proof.text: For $a=x^p\in L_1$, $\alpha_i(a)=(x^p)^{p^i}=x^{p^{i+1}}$. Every element of $L_{i+1}$ has this form, so $\alpha_i(L_1)=L_{i+1}$. Also $x^{p^{i+1}}=(x^p)^{p^i}\in L_i$, proving $L_{i+1}\subseteq L_i$; $L_0=K$ since $p^0=1$.

source.place: Tag 0CCG (varieties-remark-n-fold-relative-frobenius), iteration, specialized to power images; elementary power identities.

proof.text: Write $y\in L_i$ as $y=\alpha_i(x)$. By the given basis [def-weil-pbc-free-module], $x=\sum_{j<d}a_jb_j$ with $a_j\in L_1$. Applying the ring homomorphism $\alpha_i$ gives $y=\sum_{j<d}\alpha_i(a_j)b_j^{p^i}$ with $\alpha_i(a_j)\in L_{i+1}$. Hence the displayed family spans $L_i$ over $L_{i+1}$.

source.place: Tag 09G9 (fields-lemma-multiplicativity-degrees), basis expansion method, adapted along the ring Frobenius of varieties.tex Tag 03SM.

proof.text: If $\sum_{j<d}c_jb_j^{p^i}=0$ with $c_j\in L_{i+1}$, step 2 supplies $a_j\in L_1$ with $\alpha_i(a_j)=c_j$. The sum equals $\alpha_i(\sum_{j<d}a_jb_j)$, so injectivity from step 1 gives $\sum_{j<d}a_jb_j=0$. Uniqueness of basis coefficients [def-weil-pbc-free-module] gives $a_j=0$ and then $c_j=0$. This proves independence. Together with step 3 it is a basis of $d$ elements, so [def-weil-vector-space-dimension] and [def-pc-field-tower] give $[L_i:L_{i+1}]=d<\infty$.

source.place: Tag 09G9 (fields-lemma-multiplicativity-degrees), independence by coefficient comparison; elementary adaptation to an injective field homomorphism.

proof.text: Induct on $n$ with claim that $K/L_n$ is finite of degree $d^n$. For $n=0$, $L_0=K$ and the singleton basis $(1)$, the dimension definition [def-weil-vector-space-dimension], and the degree definition [def-pc-field-tower] give degree $1=d^0$. For the induction step, $K/L_n$ is finite by induction and $L_n/L_{n+1}$ is finite of degree $d$ by step 4. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-field-degree-multiplicativity] to $L_{n+1}\subseteq L_n\subseteq K$: it gives finiteness and $[K:L_{n+1}]=[K:L_n][L_n:L_{n+1}]=d^n d=d^{n+1}$. This proves all degree claims without assuming that Frobenius is surjective on $K$.

lean.statement: theorem frobenius_image_field_tower_degree (K : Type u) [Field K] (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) [CharP K p] (L : ℕ → Subfield K) (hL : ∀ i : ℕ, L i = (iterateFrobeniusOfPrime K hp (CharP.cast_eq_zero K p) i).fieldRange) (d : ℕ) (hd : degree (L 1) K = (d : WithTop ℕ)) (b : Module.Basis (Fin d) (L 1) K) : L 0 = ⊤ ∧ degree (L 0) K = 1 ∧ (∀ i : ℕ, ∃ α : K ≃+* L i, (∀ x : K, (α x : K) = x ^ (p ^ i)) ∧ (fun x : K ↦ (α x : K)) '' (L 1 : Set K) = (L (i + 1) : Set K) ∧ ∃ h : L (i + 1) ≤ L i, (∃ c : Module.Basis (Fin d) (L (i + 1)) (Subfield.extendScalars h), ∀ j : Fin d, (c j : K) = b j ^ (p ^ i)) ∧ degree (L (i + 1)) (Subfield.extendScalars h) = (d : WithTop ℕ)) ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, degree (L n) K = ((d ^ n : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ)
